title: [Bug] Anthropic API Error: 500 Internal Server Error with intermittent failures
body:
**Bug Description**
I'm getting repeated 500 API errors. It's stopping my work in its track, sometimes a few seconds into doing something and sometimes a few minutes.

- Terminal: iTerm.app
- Version: 2.1.56
- Feedback ID: 16c47f90-85f3-4976-96cf-f88861ca1f5f

**Errors**
